trial_name.text: Sponsor's retrospective study of Choline C 11 PET scans at the Mayo Clinic (plus a systematic review of four published studies supporting the 505(b)(2) application)

citations.quote: The sponsor's retrospective study** of 176 Choline C 11 PET scans performed at the Mayo Clinic from September 2007 to November 2010.
A systematic review of published reports identified four studies that contained data sufficient to compare ^{11}\text{C}-choline PET imaging to histopathology (truth standard)
Application Type	New Drug Application 505(b)(2)
Its study is a retrospective chart review of patients at the Mayo Clinic who had Choline C 11 positron emission tomography (PET) scans

phase.text: Not a prospective phase trial; 505(b)(2) application based on a retrospective chart review and published literature

citations.quote: Application Type	New Drug Application 505(b)(2)
There is no real primary endpoint since this was a retrospective study.

design.text: Retrospective chart review of men who underwent Choline C 11 PET to evaluate biochemical recurrence after failed initial treatment, supported by a systematic literature review of four studies comparing 11C-choline PET/CT to histopathology

citations.quote: the sponsor performed a retrospective review of the records of all patients at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN who had had a Choline C 11 PET scan for imaging of biochemical recurrence (BCR) of prostate cancer

four studies that contained data sufficient to compare ^{11}\text{C}-choline PET imaging to histopathology (truth standard) among patients with suspected prostate cancer recurrence and non-informative conventional imaging

population.text: Men with documented biochemical recurrence of prostate cancer after failed initial treatment (radical prostatectomy, radiotherapy, cryoablation, or androgen deprivation therapy)

citations.quote: Men with documented BCR of prostate cancer, defined as at least 2 separate PSA measurements greater than zero acquired 3 months apart for radical prostatectomy (RRP) patients

endpoint.text: No prespecified primary endpoint (retrospective study); FDA characterized performance as the detection rate of recurrent lesions relative to a histopathology truth standard

citations.quote: There is no real primary endpoint since this was a retrospective study.
we prefer only the term “detection rate” instead of the terms “sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive value”

n.text: 176 charts in the sponsor's retrospective study; four supporting studies (n=13, 15, 36, 34)

citations.quote: 176 charts were identified for this study.

One	13	11	2	ND*	ND*
Two	15	8	7	ND*	ND*

result.text: In the supporting studies, within each study at least half of patients with non-informative conventional imaging had positive 11C-choline PET/CT images and histologically verified recurrence (true positives: 11/13, 8/15, 23/36, 25/34). Sponsor's retrospective study reported sensitivity of 93% and specificity of 76% across all treatments, and sensitivity of 95% and specificity of 86% for prostatectomy patients.

citations.quote: within each study at least half the patients with non-informative conventional imaging had positive 11C-choline PET/CT images and histologically verified recurrent prostate cancer.

One	13	11	2	ND*	ND*
Two	15	8	7	ND*	ND*
Three	36	23	1	2	10
Four	34	25	5	0	4

Choline C 11 PET showed a sensitivity of 93% and a specificity of 76% compared with a gold standard using biopsy and imaging for patients starting all types of treatments. The Choline C 11 PET diagnostic scan shows a sensitivity of 95% and a specificity of 86% when compared with a gold standard using biopsy and imaging for RRP patients only.

indication.text: PET imaging of patients with suspected prostate cancer recurrence and non-informative bone scintigraphy, CT or MRI, to help identify potential sites of recurrence for subsequent histologic confirmation; not a replacement for histologic verification.

citations.quote: Choline C 11 Injection is indicated for positron emission tomography (PET) imaging of patients with suspected prostate cancer recurrence and non-informative bone scintigraphy, computerized tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).
11C-choline PET imaging is not a replacement for histologic verification of recurrent prostate cancer.

target_moa.text: Radiolabeled analog of choline, a precursor for cell membrane phospholipid biosynthesis; increased phospholipid synthesis (increased choline uptake) is associated with cell proliferation and transformation in tumor cells, enabling PET visualization.

citations.quote: Choline C 11 Injection is a radiolabeled analog of choline, a precursor molecule essential for the biosynthesis of cell membrane phospholipids.
phospholipid synthesis (i.e., increased uptake of choline) has been associated with cell proliferation and the transformation process that occurs in tumor cells.

modality.text: radiopharmaceutical (positron-emitting C-11 labeled choline for PET imaging)

citations.quote: Choline C 11 is a radioactive drug produced from C 11 in a cyclotron.
Carbon 11 or ^{11}\text{C} is a cyclotron-produced radionuclide that decays 99.76% to boron-11 by positron emission and has a physical half life of 20.4 minutes.

key_safety.text: Exclusive of an uncommon, mild injection site reaction, no other adverse reactions have been reported. Only 1 adverse event (a mild, self-limiting injection site reaction) was described in the sponsor's retrospective review of 176 charts. Main theoretical risk is radiation exposure (effective dose 0.0161 rem/mCi).

citations.quote: Exclusive of an uncommon, mild injection site reaction, no other adverse reactions have been reported (6).
The Mayo Clinic described only 1 adverse event in its retrospective study of 176 charts reviewed. The 1 adverse event was an injection site reaction which was mild, self-limiting, and resolved.
For an adult, the effective dose is 0.0161 rem/ mCi.

detail.text: There is no recommendation for Postmarket Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies.

citations.quote: There is no recommendation for Postmarket Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies.

vote.text: No advisory committee was convened; outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting discussion.

citations.quote: Your application for Choline C 11 Injection was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

detail.text: Approved on first review cycle; no prior CRL noted. The priority review cycle was extended three months after a major amendment prompted a clinical site inspection, and the application was then approved.

citations.quote: This application was reviewed under a priority review time line but the review cycle was extended by a major amendment that prompted a clinical site inspection. The inspectional findings raised no new concerns.
We have completed our review of this application, as amended. It is approved, effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the enclosed agreed-upon labeling text.

summary.text: Choline C 11 Injection (NDA 203-155) was a 505(b)(2) application submitted by the Mayo Clinic, received December 12, 2011, reviewed under priority review (cycle extended to a September 12, 2012 PDUFA date after a major amendment prompted a clinical site inspection), and approved on first cycle with no REMS and no postmarketing requirements or commitments; no advisory committee was convened.
